      public List<? extends LoaCustomerOrganization> listOrganizations(String ibx)
      Description copied from interface: DigitalLoas
      Lists the customer organizations available in the given IBX data center that the current user may use as a Digital LOA requestor.

      Private beta endpoint (GET /diloa/v1/organizations). The location.ibx query parameter is required by the API.

      Specified by:
      listOrganizations in interface DigitalLoas
      Parameters:
      ibx - the IBX data center identifier (e.g. AM11); required
      Returns:
      the customer organizations

    • listOrganizations

      public List<? extends LoaCustomerOrganization> listOrganizations(String ibx, List<String> productTypes)
      Description copied from interface: DigitalLoas
      Lists the customer organizations available in the given IBX data center, filtered by product type, that the current user may use as a Digital LOA requestor.

      Private beta endpoint (GET /diloa/v1/organizations). The location.ibx query parameter is required by the API; product.type is optional.

      Specified by:
      listOrganizations in interface DigitalLoas
      Parameters:
      ibx - the IBX data center identifier (e.g. AM11); required
      productTypes - the product types to filter by (e.g. CROSS_CONNECT), or null
      Returns:
      the customer organizations
